notes: registry_status=literature_implied_answer | review_focus=Check the contextual reading of “complex Radon plane” as “non-Hilbert complex Radon plane,” and verify Example 3.17's use of Lemma 3.15. The example is nonsmooth, so it cannot be a complex Hilbert plane.
